A [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]] '''individual''' served as a<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> lesser [[Noble/Legends|noble]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II||Ikree}}</ref> in the court of [[Prrit Qabaq]], the last [[Emperor-King]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nazzri]]. The noble was a fanatic and, following Qabaq's [[Death/Legends|death]] during a [[Nazzri civil war|civil war]] fought on Nazzri, murdered [[Gender/Legends|his]] daughter [[Ikree]], the first [[Monarch-praefect|queen-praefect]] of the planet's newly-established [[Nazzar government|oligarchical government]].<ref name="TOTJC" />
